beats.name: Hook
beats.spoken: everything youre watching was made by a claude code plugin called explainervideo from one script and a few screens the voice the cursor the subtitles the camera no screen recording no editing

beats.name: Cursor
beats.spoken: point it at your apps screens and claude plans every move the cursor glides it clicks and the screen changes right on cue

beats.name: Callouts
beats.spoken: brackets and a tag lock onto the button or number you name if the layout moves they move with it

beats.name: Camera
beats.spoken: then the camera moves in a smooth pan across the table a zoom into one number and back out

beats.name: Music
beats.spoken: the subtitles land on the exact word im saying and hear the music dip when i talk it drops under the voice every time and the video wont build if it doesnt

beats.name: Voice
beats.spoken: it doesnt sound like a robot either mark a line soft or mark it big and the voice acts it out

beats.name: Gates
beats.spoken: and it checks its own work two screens blurring into each other flagged text that should never be on screen caught fix it and it passes

beats.name: Install
beats.spoken: want to make your own start by installing it two commands in claude code then run setup once it fetches everything it needs to render

beats.name: The key
beats.spoken: the voice comes from elevenlabs so you bring your own key keep it in a key file never in a chat no key yet everything except the voice still works

beats.name: Ask
beats.spoken: then open claude code in your project and ask for an explainer video thats the whole prompt

beats.name: The flow
beats.spoken: claude writes the script and checks it it captures your screens it shows you the voice cost before it spends a credit then it records adds the subtitles and renders

beats.name: Review
beats.spoken: when its done a contact sheet lets you scan the whole cut at a glance

beats.name: Options
beats.spoken: a quick oneminute video is the default want chapters ask for the long form

beats.name: Get it
beats.spoken: thats it install it ask claude code for an explainer and let it do the rest
